property_summary: For any actor that locks in a guess and then settles after the lock block, the correct contract pays out 2 ether exactly when the revealed keccak(answer) matches the stored guess, whereas the buggy contract pays out exactly when the guess does NOT match, violating the rule that settlement succeeds iff the guess equals the on-chain answer.
change_summary: Change the guess-answer comparison to a strict inequality, so a correct guess no longer receives the payout.
